## Problem

For an $$m \times n$$ matrix, list its entries by walking around the outside clockwise, then continuing inward in the same spiral pattern.

**Input:**
```
3 3
2 4 6
8 10 12
14 16 18
```

**Output:** `[2, 4, 6, 12, 18, 16, 14, 8, 10]`

The result follows the outer boundary first and finishes with the center value.

### Example
Input: 3 3

```
5 1 7
3 9 2
8 4 6
```
Output: `[5, 1, 7, 2, 6, 4, 8, 3, 9]`

The traversal circles the perimeter clockwise before visiting `9` in the middle.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Visualize the matrix as layers of concentric rectangles, the spiral traversal is simply peeling off the outermost layer, then the next, and so on.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Maintain four boundaries (top, bottom, left, right) and update them after completing each side of the current layer.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

Watch for the edge case of a single row or single column to avoid duplicate entries when the boundaries meet.

</details>
